note: This file is a constants-only module with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines module-level variables used across the AugLy library for data augmentation.
summary: constants.py provides hardcoded values and asset paths for AugLy augmentations including color constants (DEFAULT_COLOR, WHITE_RGB_COLOR, RED_RGB_COLOR), media rate constants (DEFAULT_FRAME_RATE, DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE), overlay stripe line types (SUPPORTED_LINE_TYPES), asset file paths for audio (SILENT_AUDIO_PATH), image masks (IMG_MASK_PATH), emojis (EMOJI_PATH), fonts (FONT_PATH, DEFAULT_TEXT_OVERLAY_FONT_PATH, MEME_DEFAULT_FONT, SOCIAL_MEDIA_OVERLAY_FONTS), clickbait phrases (CLICKBAIT_PHRASES), and text augmentation mappings (CONTRACTIONS_MAPPING, FUN_FONTS_PATH, GENDERED_WORDS_MAPPING, etc.).
top_constants: CLICKBAIT_PHRASES - list of 25 clickbait phrases for overlay_random_text_with_background augmentation
SOCIAL_MEDIA_OVERLAY_FONTS - list of 7 font file paths for social media style text overlays
SUPPORTED_LINE_TYPES - list of 3 line types (dotted, dashed, solid) for overlay_stripes augmentation
GENDERED_WORDS_MAPPING - path to gendered words mapping JSON for swap_gendered_words text fairness augmentation
Color and rate constants - DEFAULT_COLOR, WHITE_RGB_COLOR, RED_RGB_COLOR, DEFAULT_FRAME_RATE, DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE
